_about: Deep-discovery schema for ULIPs (v1). One JSON file per product: features/ulip/<UIN>.json. Every field is an object {value, status, doc, page, quote, note}. 'doc' = the website's own label for the document (e.g. 'Policy Bond', 'Product Brochure/Prospectus'). 'quote' = verbatim text (<= 300 chars). Leave value null and set status 'not stated in public documents' when you cannot find it - never guess.

product.uin: UIN exactly as printed in the policy document
product.uin_in_brochure: UIN printed in brochure (version may differ)
product.launch_or_version_date: if printed (e.g. 'ADVT No' date / form version)
product.variants_or_plan_options: list of variants/options with one-line description each (e.g. 'Platinum', 'Classic Waiver', 'Life Option')
product.target_segment_stated: if the brochure states a target (e.g. HNI, women, child, retirement)
product.online_offline: online only / offline / both, as stated

eligibility.sum_assured_rule: e.g. 'higher of 10x AP or 0.5 x PT x AP' (regular), '1.25x SP' (single), choices offered
eligibility.life_cover_multiple_choice: can the customer choose the cover multiple? range

charges.premium_allocation_charge: % of premium by policy year (table) - note if differs by channel (online) or premium size
charges.policy_administration_charge: amount or % and its inflation/cap, by year
charges.fund_management_charge: per fund (see funds) - also give min-max
charges.mortality_charge: basis (e.g. per 1000 sum at risk), table reference/annexure, whether rates are published
charges.discontinuance_charge: table by year of discontinuance (IRDAI caps)
charges.switching_charge: free switches per year and charge thereafter
charges.partial_withdrawal_charge: free withdrawals per year and charge thereafter
charges.any_charge_returned: return of mortality / allocation / admin / FMC charges - which, when, how much

benefits.death_benefit_formula: e.g. higher of SA, FV, 105% of premiums; any options (Life / Life+ / Classic Waiver)
benefits.loyalty_additions: schedule + formula (e.g. 0.5% of avg FV every year from year 6)
benefits.return_of_mortality_charges: when and how much (e.g. 100% at maturity)

flexibility.partial_withdrawals: from which year, limits, min/max amount
flexibility.auto_portfolio_strategies: names + mechanics (life-cycle, STP/trigger, auto rebalance, return protector)

funds.fund_count: number of funds available for this product
funds.fund_list: array of {name, SFIN, FMC_pct, asset_allocation (equity/debt/money market ranges), risk_label}
funds.index_or_thematic_funds: list of index / thematic / new funds (NFO) available

protection_add_ons.waiver_of_premium_inbuilt: e.g. on death of parent / proposer (child ULIP)

documents_inventory: array of {website_label, doc_type (brochure|policy_document|CIS|BI|leaflet|fund_factsheet|other), url, found_on_page_url, pages, stored_path}
new_features_not_in_schema: array of {feature, description, quote, doc, page} - anything distinctive this product has that the schema does not cover
data_not_public: array of fields that the documents say are 'as per policy schedule' / 'available on request' / not disclosed
